evals.prompt: Create a Miro-compatible Mermaid diagram for a checkpointed LLM job. It has fresh and resume paths, input and results checkpoint tables, and only sends unfinished rows to the model.
evals.expected_output: A conservative colored flowchart using quoted newline labels, individual edges, database shapes for checkpoint tables, and explicit input-minus-results resume logic.

evals.prompt:
My Miro Mermaid chart fails after I added classDef colors,
labels, and chained arrows. Fix it but keep color.
evals.expected_output: A Miro-safe chart that removes HTML and class syntax, replaces line breaks with quoted \n, separates chained edges, and uses per-node style statements.

evals.prompt: Create a high-level data lineage graph for product tables, demand tables, prepared LLM input, an LLM process, and Bronze/Silver/Gold serving tables. Show dataset.table and logical grain on artifacts.
evals.expected_output: An artifact-centered graph with separate physical source nodes, grain labels for persisted business artifacts, process-only LLM node, and serving table sinks.
